entity_types.label: Place
entity_types.reason: Many mentions are named places that recur across sessions (Europe, UK, Lake Winnebago).

entity_types.label: Event
entity_types.reason: Top texts are generic (trip, reunion, workshop), and low cross-session recurrence means the same wording is a different event each time.

entity_types.label: Organization
entity_types.reason: Mostly capitalized (74%) named companies that recur (Emirates, YouTube).

entity_types.label: Product
entity_types.reason: Generic item nouns (mirror, wide-angle lens) with very low cross-session recurrence (2%).

entity_types.label: Food
entity_types.reason: Generic food nouns (herbs, meat); the same words in different sessions are not the same thing.

entity_types.label: Activity
entity_types.reason: Generic activity nouns (hiking, workout) with low recurrence.

entity_types.label: Project
entity_types.reason: Generic texts (projects, tasks) with low recurrence.

entity_types.label: Language
entity_types.reason: Small set of distinct names that recur across sessions (Python, Japanese).

entity_types.label: Topic
entity_types.reason: Very many distinct generic subject nouns.

entity_types.label: Occupation
entity_types.reason: A role name means the same thing wherever it appears, and it has the higher cross-session recurrence (12%).

dropped_types.label: MedicalProcedure
dropped_types.reason: Its only relation was dropped, and its mentions are mostly noise (rule of thirds, HDR, proof-of-stake).
